item.title: The North Face and Vans Parent Reports Revenue Growth, Driven by Americas
item.description: A strong holiday season, ecommerce and Americas drove better-than-expected results at VF Corp. TNF and Timberland reported growth while Vans' turnaround is still in progress.

item.title: Columbia Sportswear Targets Super Bowl Fans with Bear Poop Beer
item.description: The beer, aimed to bring "a taste of the outdoors" to sports fans stuck inside, is part of Columbia's head-turning new marketing strategy.

item.title: On Announces Appointment of New Chief Financial Officer
item.description: Frank Sluis will join the company as CFO effective May 1.

item.title: Boot Barn Celebrates Return to Huntington Beach with New Store
item.description: Boot Barn’s return to Huntington Beach arrives alongside several new store openings across the nation throughout January.

item.title: HOKA Introduces Cielo X1 3.0
item.description: Cielo X1 3.0 is the brand’s lightest super shoe to date, engineered to minimize weight and maximize performance.

item.title: Strong U.S. Demand for HOKA and UGG Drive Record Results at Deckers Brands
item.description: Tariffs had less of an impact on third-quarter results than expected as both DTC and wholesale sales grew at HOKA and UGG.

item.title: Solo Stove Launches New Campaign
item.description: Solo Stove "Squashes the Beef at the Big Game," turning rivalries into connection over fire and food.

item.title: City of Malden Launches “Outdoor Rx” Pilot Program
item.description: The program is for Massachusetts residents and individuals with disabilities.

item.title: KETL Mtn. Apparel Launches Two New Treasure Hunts
item.description: The outdoor travel apparel brand launches edition 4 and edition 5 of its real-world treasure hunts, hiding cash and gift cards across wild landscapes around Nevada and Phoenix, Arizona.

item.title: Outside Days Industry Conference Announces First Wave of Featured Speakers
item.description: Expanded event builds on the success of the Outside Summit with new tracks and two full days of programming and networking, May 28-29.
